verdict.rationale: Secureframe's docs describe continuous daily monitoring of connected systems through 100+ integrations, with automated tests and proactive email alerts when tests fail. Failing tests also appear in a central view, and data pushed via API or CSV is tested as well. missing for 10: evidence of sub-daily test cadence (the docs say 'daily', which may not meet 'within hours'), independent or hands-on corroboration of alert timeliness.
